subject: Post-discovery: request to book 60–90m ML/infra runthrough and attendee roster
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@novacorp.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: request to book 60–90m ML/infra runthrough and attendee roster

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation today — super useful to hear more about NovaCorp's latency targets and the cohort-level inference pattern you described. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Goal for next meeting: 60–90 minute technical runthrough with your ML and infra teams to demo a representative workload, walk through routing/fallback options, and align on performance/cost tradeoffs.
- Ask: can you confirm the engineering/ML stakeholders who should join (examples: lead ML engineer, infra/ops owner, security reviewer)?
- Proposed slots (PDT): 
  • Wed Sep 2, 10:00–11:30 
  • Thu Sep 3, 13:00–14:30 
  • Fri Sep 4, 09:00–10:30

If none of those work, send two windows that fit your team's schedule and we'll prioritize.

Prep we’ll do: bring a short runbook-style demo, a sizing sketch based on your described QPS, and a draft mutual action plan (attached). Please share any pre-reads or perf concerns (e.g., SOC2 evidence, data residency constraints) so we can pull the right folks.

Attachments: redwood_post_discovery_notes.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

Thanks — happy to adjust the agenda if you want more focus on cost or on edge deployment patterns.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Appreciate the recap. We’re keen to move forward with a technical runthrough. Tom (cc’d) is our ML lead and will be essential for the deep-dive. Security has been looped in for the SOC2/controls ask.

Tom and I can make the Wed Sep 2 10:00–11:30 PDT slot. Security may be an observer; they asked for an initial SOC2 artifact and a brief note on data retention — can you share the SOC2 summary and a one-paragraph note on retention policy during the call?

Attendee list from our side:
- Elena Park, Dir. Product (owner)
- Tom Nguyen, Lead ML Engineer
- sec-team@novacorp.com (infosec intake)

We’ll plan for 60 minutes to start. If you need Tom to do any pre-call work (sample payloads, dataset sizes), let us know.

Thanks,
Elena

Thanks — Wed Sep 2 10:00–11:30 PDT is booked on our side. I’m looping in the engineers who will run the demo and own the infra conversation so we have the right people on the call: 
- Marissa Cole (Solutions Engineer) — will run the demo and lead the runbook walkthrough
- Marcus Lin (Infra PM) — will own sizing and routing/fallback discussion
- Neha Kapoor (CS) — will join for mutual action plan and success criteria alignment

Quick internal asks for the run:
- Elena/Tom: can you share a representative input size and average tokens per request (ballpark is fine) so Marissa can prep the demo dataset?
- Security: we’ll bring a SOC2 summary and a one-paragraph data retention note during the call; I’ll attach the SOC2 summary to the invite.

Draft agenda (60m):
1) 5m — intros & success criteria
2) 20m — demo: representative workload + runbook steps (Marissa)
3) 15m — capacity, latency targets, and routing/fallback options (Marcus)
4) 10m — security & compliance Q&A (Rishi/Neha)
5) 10m — next steps & mutual action items

Marissa — want to confirm you can demo with ~1k token sequences and a small batching scenario? Marcus — can you bring the quick sizing notes for a 50–100 QPS steady-state?

Elena — I’ll send the calendar invite with attachments (SOC2 summary + post-discovery notes) for Wed Sep 2 10:00 PDT. If anything changes on your side, flag it and we’ll pivot.

Best,
Rishi
